typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must be ≥ 18 years of age
Patient must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 2

typedChecks.name: anti-VEGF agent
typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must not have received any prior treatment with an anti-VEGF agent

typedChecks.name: investigational drug
typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must not have had treatment with any investigational drug within five half-lives or 3 months (whichever is greater), prior to study initiation

typedChecks.name: EGFR TKI
typedChecks.sourceText: Prior treatment with an EGFR TKI is not allowed, however if a candidate for this study has already started osimertinib within 21 days prior to randomization... the patient will be eligible

typedChecks.name: prior systemic treatment for metastatic disease
typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must not have had any prior systemic treatment for metastatic disease

typedChecks.qualifier: treated or untreated stable without steroids
typedChecks.sourceText: Patients with treated brain metastases are eligible if neurologically stable without glucocorticoid therapy after the stated washout period from radiation therapy (RT) or surgery provided the metastatic lesions are non-hemorrhagic / Patients with untreated brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease are eligible if the treating physician determines that immediate CNS specific treatment is not required provided the metastatic lesions are non-hemorrhagic and are neurologically stable without glucocorticoid therapy
Leukocytes >= 3,000/mcL (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
Absolute neutrophil count >= 1,500/mcL (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
Platelets >= 100,000/mcL (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
Hemoglobin >= 9 g/dL (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
Total bilirubin and creatinine =< 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
Total bilirubin and creatinine =< 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)

Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (serum glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase [SGOT])/alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase [SGPT]) =< 2.5 x institutional ULN (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)

Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (serum glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase [SGOT])/alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase [SGPT]) =< 2.5 x institutional ULN (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
Patient must not have mean resting corrected QT interval (QTc) > 470 msec obtained from 3 electrocardiograms (ECGs)
Participants must have histologically confirmed Stage IV or recurrent Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) of non-squamous (NSQ) histology
Participants must have measurable PD-L1 ≥ 1% Tumor Cell (TC) score
minimumAge: 18 Years
Participants must have an Easter Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of ≤ 1 at screening.

typedChecks.drugOrClass: systemic anti-cancer therapy given as primary therapy for advanced or metastatic disease
typedChecks.sourceText: with no prior systemic anti-cancer therapy given as primary therapy for advanced or metastatic disease.

Participants with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK), or ROS-1 mutations that are sensitive to available targeted inhibitor therapy. Participants with unknown EGFR, ALK, or ROS-1 status are excluded.

typedChecks.biomarkerName: BRAFV600E mutations, activating RET mutations or NTRK fusion gene alterations
typedChecks.sourceText: Participants with known BRAFV600E mutations, that are sensitive to available targeted inhibitor therapy; participants with known activating rearranged during transfection (RET) mutations or neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) fusion gene alterations are excluded.
Participants must not have untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.

typedChecks.drugOrClass: anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or anti-CTLA-4 antibody, or any other antibody or drug specifically targeting T-cell co-stimulation or checkpoint pathways
typedChecks.sourceText: Prior treatment with an anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or anti-CTLA-4 antibody, or any other antibody or drug specifically targeting T-cell co-stimulation or checkpoint pathways.
